summary: Publishes an input TOP as one or more DirectX shared textures for Windows DirectX interop.
common_gotchas: Queue size changes interop latency and stability; larger queues may hide consumer stalls.
Use Info DAT for handles instead of guessing them.
This exports to DirectX interop, not normal in-network TOP wiring.
This operator is Windows/license gated and should not be planned for macOS projects.
key_concepts: DirectX Out TOP exposes TOP images as DirectX shared textures.
DirectX applications or DirectX In TOP can consume the shared texture handles.
It uses DirectX Sharing Resources and supports DirectX 9.0 or later interop.
Queue Size creates multiple textures updated cyclically to help consumers keep up.
Info DAT is the normal place to inspect the exported texture handles.
The operator is Windows-only and available for Educational, Commercial, and Pro licenses.
